_about: Feat loop, batch 2, styles lane (2026-11-22): the style feats and their follow-ups, and the
reroll and once-a-day luck feats. Each benefit is the book's (the benefit text in feats.json,
from aonprd.com / d20pfsrd.com). A style is a stance (rules/styles.py): its follow-ups ask
`bearer.state` for `style.<id>`, and a base style's clauses not prefaced by 'while using this
style' hold always. Luck is a document's `luck` list, read by rules/luck.py at the engine's
d20 doors. What still does not run is the document's `not_yet`.

not_yet: the free-action Intimidate to demoralize after a reroll that succeeds: no door demoralizes as a free action off a roll
the reroll is still offered on a save against a trap: a save's roll does not say what forced it
initiative, concentration and the saves a spell or a hazard rolls for you: only the attack roll, a save the turn calls for, and a skill or ability check carry luck
the standard action that guards adjacent allies (+2 dodge against one opponent's next melee attack, -2 AC to you against it): no door lays a guard on an ally against one attacker
the speed a foe loses when your attack of opportunity deals 10 or more, and the free trip when it meets its remaining move: an attack of opportunity's damage is read by no style hook

modifiers.note: Monkey Lunge: no -2 AC for lunging, under a light load

not_yet: only when the lunge is a standard action: the AC term holds after a full attack's lunge too
it waits on Lunge's stance (lane b2-actions, `buff.stance.lunging`): until that merges no lunge lays it
slashing damage with your unarmed strikes (a free action to change): an unarmed strike's damage type is fixed

the extra 1d6 bleed at the start of the torn foe's turn: a second bleed of the same kind does not stack with tear flesh's 2d6 by the book, and nothing distinguishes it
